high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "humanhood.official." The post is part of a series titled "30 life lessons from a 90 year old," and it is currently on slide 2 out of 6, as indicated by the "2/6" in the top right corner. The content of the post includes five numbered life lessons: It's okay to let your children see you cry. When it comes to going after what you love in life, don't take 'no' for an answer. Over prepare, then go with the flow.
